# OLYMPUS v0.0.12, "Stack and clear": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-08 for the round's four implementers (drill, house, scene, face) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then COMBAT §25 and the sections it cites); my own choices are marked (my call) and every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.2's 0.0.7d row, shipped as v0.0.12: `test-shoothouse`, "Stack and clear" (the Tests menu's entry after "Bang"), **at 1 G in the Wheel's house 1** (PLACES §4.15: X4's design, layout A, sector 4, gravity `spin`): a lane of three rooms and the hall (§2.1) with turners, no-shoots, an armoured silhouette, a hostage card, a locked inner door and a dummy round; your **#2**, a generated marine of your fire team on your sheet's tier, on the same stepper and bundles; **the instructor** on the catwalk. **Stack and clear on GO**: the recruit step by step (Stack on the door, the door's row, X, the walk in by the movement keys, the pause at his take-in), the tier one by T (the bundle runs the stack, the door, the entry and the corners, handing back where COMBAT §25.8.2 says). **Pars by tone, not wounds**; the run sheet and the hot wash; the picker (Boot recruit, Private focused, Corporal, Sergeant, Raider, Tier one) and "Again as …" on the same seed. Scored on **the pause**, **the drill**, **the shots**.

**What the user must feel.** The recruit stops in the doorway a third of a second while the brackets close round a man he did not expect, then aims, then fires, about 2 s from the man seeing him, every press his. The tier one's line reads "T: Clear the house" with its planned time, and he flows: the door opens as he reaches it, his eyes are on the far corner when the man is there, one tick, and the shot is his choice. Same rooms, rules and rolls; only the time and what one press covers differ (the user, 2026-11-07: "no watering down but factor in experience in how smooth and fast we do things"). The #2 is a teammate. The Wheel is a hall: 1 G, no sky, an echo, black suits.

**The user's rules hold over every section** (DESIGN.md; the brief's seven): the house authored, what happens in it procedural from the seed; all people generated; every environment number from `src/sim/places/env.js` (TECH §1.4); 16 px/m chibi; every image and sound by code; the Corps red and black, armour black; no overlapping UI; AZERTY labels on physical codes; never a dead end; every DI line names a row the panel has and T does it, never the shot; actions over 10 s behind the brief splash. **Built and starred, kept as they are**: react.js, contact.js, the shot rows, the reloads by purpose, supp.js, "Three bangs", "Bang", every shipped scene's pins (§3.3).

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1), any other edit reported exactly; no commits, tags, pushes, releases or promotions; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201, `../longhaul`, `../tradecraft` or `docs/research/`; scratch under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r12/<role>/`. **Ports**: drill 8231, house 8232, scene 8233, face 8234; integrator 8236; reviews 8237 to 8239 (`OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT` for single suites; the parallel runner claims 8240 to 8249 itself); kill every server. Tests: `node tests/run.mjs '<file> ›'`, `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` (60 s); a ceiling failing under load is rerun alone before it is believed. Look at what you build (`tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m). Docs and CHANGELOG.md are the lead's: return bullets and doc items.

**Interfaces first.** Each role writes §2's exports as stubs with the shapes given, then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: house, drill, scene, face; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each.

## 2. Interfaces

### 2.1 house: the place, the plans, the spin, the suit

**The area** (`wheel.js` `WHEEL_S4`, in AREA_LIST and `MELAS_SITE.areas`): `{ id: 'melas.wheel.s4', site: 'melas', kind: 'deck', code: 'w4', name: 'The Wheel, sector 4', boundsM: { x0: 0, z0: 0, x1: 40, z1: 28 }, gravity: { regime: 'spin', gG: 1, spin: { radiusM: 500, omegaRadS: 0.1347, alongRad: 0 } }, sky: 'none', rooms, openings, fixtures, zones, portals: [], look }`. Frame: x along the spin (east, prograde), z across the band (south). House 1 is 30 × 20 m at (5, 4) to (35, 24) of ballistic panel walls; **the hall runs along x** (2.4 m wide), the lane's rooms off it with **their depths across the band** (§8 item 17). Openings carry `swing: { hinge: 'a' | 'b', into: <room index> }`, `lock` (the closet's), `kickDc`. Floors `concrete`, the apron `deckPlate`. Lit by the base's clock (day 0.75 at 10:00); room 3 is class `cqbDim` (`MOODS.dim` fill 0.40: the shot's −2, the take-in ×1.13).

**Lane A** (`HOUSE1`; my layout, positions the house's to author within these rules):
- **The start mark** at the hall's east end, on its axis, its path to room 1's #1 stack point **4.0 ± 0.05 m** (§25.5.1); the #2's start 0.65 m behind.
- **Room 1**, north of the hall: §25.5.1 exactly: 5.0 m along x by 4.0 m deep, its door 0.9 m wide in the middle of the near wall, opening inward, hinged on the left as seen from the hall (west). #1 stacks right (east), enters left (a cross); his point 1.0 m along the near wall from the near-left corner and 0.5 m off it (the path 2.72 ± 0.05 m; the door's plane at 0.8 m, the threshold 1.1 m along it). Stands: **1a** the far left corner, 4.4 m from the threshold, #1's (always a threat; facing from GO); **1b** the far right corner, the #2's sector (a threat or a no-shoot by the seed, facing from GO).
- **Room 2**, south, corner-fed: 5.5 × 5.0 m, its door at its west corner, opening **outward** into the hall (a pull); the entry a hook along the near wall. Stands: **2a** the armoured silhouette, a turner (`door` trigger: it turns 300 to 1,200 ms after the door is open, whole ticks); **2b** a no-shoot by the inner door (facing from GO). **The inner door** on the east wall, `door`, `lock: { kind: 'key' }`, `kickDc` 14, into a closet of 1.2 × 1.5 m, empty.
- **Room 3**, north: an L, its near leg 4.0 × 6.8 m, its far leg 4.0 × 3.5 m to the east, door inward; class `cqbDim`. Stands: **3a** in the near leg's far corner, the #2's sector (a threat or a no-shoot by the seed; a turner on the `door` trigger, 500 to 1,500 ms); **3b** the hostage card in the far leg, seen only past the leg's middle (facing from GO).
- **The hall's end**: stand **H** at the hall's west end, 10.0 m from room 3's door, a turner on the `zone` trigger (the player into `w4.z.hallWest`, then 1,500 to 3,000 ms).
- **The catwalk** at y 3.0 m over the lane's rooms along x (a polyline), stairs at its east end; **the booth** by the start mark.

**The plans** (`x4-plans.js` `X4_PLANS.A`, frozen, golden-hashed): by door id, `{ room, door, threshold: [x, z], entry: 'cross' | 'hook', stack: [[x, z], [x, z]], points: [[x, z], [x, z]], corners: [{ id, x, z }], hot: [{ id, x, z, why: 'behind the door' | 'corner' | 'far leg' }], sectors: [{ slot, yawRad, halfDeg: 20 }], dead: [[x, z, rM]], paths: { 1: [[x, z], …], 2: [[x, z], …] }, inner: [openingId] | [], light: 'day' | 'dim' }`; `hall: { … }` the same shape for the last leg (stack: the room 3 door's exit; points: the hall's end mark); `order: ['o:w4:r1', 'o:w4:r2', 'o:w4:r3', 'hall']`. Points are 0.4 m or more off every wall; corners and sectors see 98% of each room's floor cells from the points (§25.13's `combat-rooms`).

**`room.js`** (pure; plans cached in `state.$rooms` by door, never saved):
- `roomPlanOf(state, doorId) → plan | null`; `lanePlanOf(state) → { lane: 'A', order, plans }`; `roomOfDoor(doorId)`, `doorOfRoom(roomId)`.
- `inFunnel(plan, x, z) → boolean`: within `FUNNEL_M` 0.5 of the door's plane and between its jambs widened 0.3 m.
- `pastThreshold(plan, x, z) → boolean`: inside the room by more than `THRESHOLD_M` 0.3.
- `coveredNow(state, plan, actor, ms) → [hotId]`: the hot spots within `SECTOR_HALF_DEG` 20° of the actor's muzzle yaw or head yaw, a clear line (`perception.js clearLine`), the actor past the threshold.

**`spin.js`** (pure; R and ω read from `gravityAt(state, area).spin`, never written elsewhere):
- `spinOf(state, area = null) → { omegaRadS, radiusM, alongRad, acrossK } | null` (`acrossK` = g_Mars / 1 G = 0.38: the radial share of the across-band direction on the banked floor).
- `bodyPushOf(spin, { vx, vz }) → { alongK, acrossK }`: `2 ω v / G0` along the spin (heavier prograde), × 0.38 across.
- `spinBiasCm(spin, { rangeM, vMs, bearingRad }) → { upCm, sideCm }`: `ω d² / v`; prograde low, retrograde high, across sideways × 0.38 (signs as `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/1g/spin.py`'s inertial check).

**`turners.js`**: the record gains `room`, `stand`, `name`, `slot`, `trigger: { kind: 'go' | 'door' | 'zone', id, gapMs }`, and the face `'hostage'`; `turnerTargets` takes `T.name` where given and carries `room` (the bay's words unchanged).

**`kit.js`**: `CONTAINERS['ces-1'] = { type: 'suit', word: 'combat EVA suit', slot: 'suit', visor: true, massKg: 16, colour: 'black' }`; `SLOTS` gains `'suit'`; `KIT_TEMPLATES['house-cqb'] = { worn: { suit: 'ces-1', carrier: 'pc-m3', sling: 'r7' }, carrier: ['pouch-mag2', 'pouch-mag2', 'pouch-dump'], mags: [['had30', 10, 'frangible'], ['had30', 10, 'frangible'], ['had30', 10, 'frangible']], cond: 0.93, posture: 'lowReady' }` (no ear defenders: the suit filters); `kitMassKg(state, pid) → kg` (the worn items, the rifle and the magazines: 25 ± 1.5 kg here). `supp.js protOf` already reads `{ visor: true, ears: 'suit' }`.

### 2.2 drill: the stepper, the bundles, the stances, the DI

**`stepper.js`**: v0.0.5's step machinery out of `shooting.js` (`startStep`, `runSub`'s timing, `endSub`, `advance`, `queueAfter`, `endStep`'s timing), plus channels. A doing record with `list` (no `beats`) runs exactly as built (`scene-handling` byte for byte); one with `beats` runs channels.
- `CHANNELS = ['feet', 'hands', 'eyes', 'voice', 'world']`; `flowOf(rung) → Set`: the channels that may overlap: none to rung 2 (one beat at a time), `hands` and `voice` with `feet` at 3, `eyes` too at 4.
- `registerKind(kind, { run(state, bus, d, beat, atMs) → { ms, ok, grade, routine, mishap, text }, end(state, bus, d, beat) })`: the beat kinds' handlers (`bundle.js` registers `move`, `posture`, `aim:point`, `door`, `scan`, `call`, `mark`, `wait`; `shooting.js` keeps the rifle's sub-kinds as its handler).
- `begin(state, bus, d, atMs)`, `due(d) → ms`, `advance(state, bus, d, ms) → 'running' | 'ended' | 'halted'`: at each boundary the beat ends, then every beat whose channel is free (and allowed by `flowOf`) and whose `after` is met starts (`'approach@0.85'` a share, `'door@pass'` the leaf passable); boundaries at formula times, taken on the first tick at or after (TIME §4.3). Any doing record (the player's `state.stop.doing`, the #2's `R.house.two.doing`) runs through it.
- `halt(state, bus, d, why, words)`: the rest into `queue` as "Carry on: …" (`why` one of `HALTS`).

**`drills/enter-and-clear.js`** `ENTER_AND_CLEAR`: §25.7.2 as written, amended: `room:stack` and `room:open` are **rung 0 singles** (§8 item 8); `room:stack-open`, `room:enter`, `room:dominate` rung 2; `room:clear` rung 3; `house:clear` rung 4 (`lane: true`, the plan's order, the hall's leg as its last); `room:limited` and `room:slice` stay in the data, `offeredNow: false` (§7). `variants: { breach: ['push', 'pull', 'kick'], entry: ['cross', 'hook'], stance: ['assault', 'combat'] }`. `halts`: `contact`, `noshoot`, `refused` (locked), `door-unplanned`, `two` (the #2 not in place), `gun`, `fail`, `seam`, `lane-end`, `stop` (Backspace or X).

**`bundle.js`**:
- `singleRows(state, pid, ms) → rows`: always in the panel where they apply, every rung: **Stack on the door** (`drill:room:stack>${door}`: move to the slot's stack point in Combat, high ready, the muzzle onto the door), **the door's rows** (`door:push>${id}` "Push it open", `door:pull>${id}` "Pull it open", `door:kick>${id}` "Kick it · 1.2 s · 70% (Fitness)", `door:read>${id}` "Read the door · 0.7 s"; the swing decides push or pull; a lock strikes push and pull "locked"), **Watch** (`watch:${hotId}`), **Look** (`look:${hotId}`, inside a room), **Move** (`move:point`, `move:hallEnd`: inside a room or along the hall, never through the plane of a door into a room not yet cleared below rung 2), **Hold it** (`door:hold>${id}`: the #2's muzzle on an unplanned door), **Call** (`call:clear` "Clear!"), **Mark** (`mark`), **the gait** (`gait:relaxed | combat | assault`), and **X go** (`leave`, labelled "go: the clock runs, the keys move you" at a door below rung 2).
- `bundleRows(state, pid, ms) → rows`: each `{ id: 'drill:<bundle>[@<variant>][><door>]', kind: 'bundle', label, ms, beats: [{ id, k, ch, ms }], seams: [beatIndex], rung, variant, off?, struck? }`; offered where `offered(state, pid, b)`; taught, not lived: struck "by hand first" once. Variant rows set at no time: "Cross ⇄ Hook", "Push ⇄ Kick", "Assault ⇄ Combat".
- `planBundle(state, pid, bundleId, { door, slot = 1, variant, rung, atMs }) → { beats, ms, seams, odds }`: each beat's time by §4's formulas, `paceOf` on its skill, ×1.6 on a failed roll.
- `startBundle(state, bus, pid, rowId, { tempo }) → { ok, why }`; rushed (Shift) ×0.6 and −3, never routine.
- `bundleNow(state, pid = player) → { id, label, lanes: { feet, hands, eyes, voice: [{ id, glyph: '✓' | '◦' | '✗' | '·' | '▸' }] }, fromMs, untilMs, k } | null`.
- `runSlot(state, bus, rec, ms)`: an NPC's slot (the #2) through the same plan and stepper: rung 0 to 2 one step at a time with `goMs(WF)` between, cued on #1's crossing (`think`).
- `moveAt(beat, ms) → { x, z, vMs, headRad }`: a move beat's closed-form trapezoid along its path at the stance's speed, pushing and braking at `tractionOf`'s.
- **Hand-backs** (COMBAT §25.8.2, the rest queued as Carry on): a person newly seen (the pause, after the take-in); an identified no-shoot; a door that will not open ("Locked. Kick it, or hold it."); a door the plan does not take ("Door, east wall. Hold it or clear it?"); the #2 over `TWO_SLOT_M` 1.5 m from his slot `TWO_WAIT_MS` 3 s after #1 is ready ("Your number two's not with you."); the gun; a failed roll not routine; a seam below the rung; the lane's end. A bundle never fires, picks, reloads, spends, crosses an unplanned door or goes past a contact; **below rung 2 nothing but the keys crosses a door's plane into a room not yet cleared** (the user: "then would move in using movement keys (game unpaused with X)").

**`templates.js`**: test sheets write `drills: { room: { rung, reps: 0, lived: <every bundle of its rung>, atMs: null, fixed: true }, passage: { … } }`; `offered(state, pid, bundle) → boolean` (`rungOf(state, pid, b.family) >= b.rung && (b.rung === 0 || lived)`); `REPS_PRACTISED` 20, `REPS_DRILLED` 60 (counted only on a sheet that is not fixed).

**`motion.js`**: `gaitSpeeds({ …, gait = 'relaxed' })`: `GAIT_K = { relaxed: { walk: 1, run: 1 }, combat: { walk: 0.85, run: 1 }, assault: { walk: 1.4, run: 1 } }` on the rounded walk, rounded to 0.01 (1 G: Combat 1.23, Assault 2.03 m/s; Melas 0.97 and 1.60); `tractionOf({ gMs2, mu, effFitness, massKg, loadKg }) → { pushMs2, brakeMs2 }` (BODY §16.2: `min(μ g, 4.0 (0.8 + 0.02 F) / r)` and `min(μ g, 6.5 (0.8 + 0.02 F) / r)`, `r = (massKg + loadKg) / massKg`).

**`move.js`**: in the `combat` and `assault` gaits the body's velocity moves toward the keys' wanted velocity at push and brake (a seam's cost is physical); `relaxed` (and an absent gait) keeps the built instant speeds. A running `move` beat sets the actor's position from `moveAt` and the keys' movement is ignored.

**`react.js`**: `takeInMs` reads `stanceK` from the actor (`relaxed` 1.25 only with `gait === 'relaxed'` set and the rifle slung; `assault` 1.1 below rung 2; else 1), `lightK(lightLevel(state, t.x, t.z, ms))`, `whoK` 1.5 for a `hostage` face too; `heldSectorOf(state, pid, ms) → { yawRad, why } | null`: a Watch (`state.stop.watch`), a running `scan` beat's sector, or the bundle's eyes on its slot's corner, which `expectOf` reads as `sector` beside the muzzle's rule; `state.mind.clearing` gives `area` (written by the scene).

**`contact.js`**: during a window, a not pre-armed player in Combat or Assault carries on for `goMs` then brakes at `brakeMs2` (BODY §16.2's 0.24 m for the private at 1 G); a Watch or a running bundle is pre-armed. At the pause a bundle's rest is "Carry on: <rest> · <s>" (`drill:carry`). `targetName` reads the record's name.

**`specials.js` and `shot.js`**: with a move running at the pause, each shot row comes in two, `shot:<row>@moving` ("Pair, moving on · −2") and `shot:<row>@planted` (the body brakes first); moving in Combat −4 (−2 from Marksmanship 15); in Assault from rung 2 within 10 m `mitigated(−8, MRK, 30, 0.25)`, below rung 2 the moving rows struck "plant first". `poiOf` adds `spinBiasCm` to the hole as the wind's (no `biasMod` under 2.5 cm on a torso: the odds do not move). A `hostage` face puts To the head first and strikes the torso rows "the hostage"; the armoured leads with the failure drill as built.

**`shooting.js`**: `stepsOf` gains, in the house, `singleRows` and `bundleRows` (the bundle first at its door, like a Corps command), the contact's Carry on, and the variants; `targetsOf` lists `R.turners` when `R.area` is the live area; `gaitAction(state, bus)` (V in the house: Relaxed → Combat → Assault, the posture following: slung, low ready, shouldered); `state.stop.watch = { hotId, yawRad, fromMs } | null`.

**`instinct/cqb.js`** `CQB_RULES`: COMBAT §25.8.3's table (tiers by Tactics, the shots' by Marksmanship; four phrasings each; the marine's own thought from rung 3; silent in a take-in; an act only when its row is in the panel), with `cqb-method` and `cqb-unknown` left out (§7) and four added: `cqb-hostage` ("Hostage. Head only, or hold.": the aim), `cqb-locked` and `cqb-unplanned` (Hold it), `cqb-two` (Wait). **`cqb-go` at rungs 0 and 1 acts X go**, the walk's keycaps shown, never the feet (§8 item 9); `cqb-funnel` below rung 2 acts `move:point` once past the threshold, else "Out of the door. Keys, in." with no act. Acts: `stop:drill:<bundle>[@<variant>][><door>]`, `stop:door:<verb>><id>`, `stop:look:<hot>`, `stop:move:<to>`, `stop:call:clear`, `stop:leave`.

### 2.3 scene: the lane, the #2, the instructor, the run sheet

The house rides the range session (`course: 'house'`, the instructor its RO, `R.house` its record, §3); every house branch in `handling.js` is guarded by `R.course === 'house'`.

- `testShoothouse(state, { tier = 'private', par = null, setup = null }) `: the barracks drawn; the player on the start mark facing west in the suit (`house-cqb` issue materialised: magazine 1 holds the dummy as its round 3 to 6 on `stream(seed, 'house:dummy')`, §8 item 11), `testSheet(tier)`, gait `combat`; the #2 (`stream(seed, 'house:two')` over your fire team, the same marine on every sheet, `testSheet(tier)` written on him for the scene) 0.65 m behind; the instructor (`drawStaff(state, 'melas:wheel-house-chief')`) at the booth; the stands' faces and holds on `stream(seed, 'house:draw', stand)` (1b and 3a: threat 50, no-shoot 50; threats rifle 70, pistol 30; no-shoots hands 60, phone 40), their gaps on `stream(seed, 'house:gap', stand)`; then `startRange(state, bus, { course: 'house', lane: null, kit, set: { mag: 1, n, kind: 'dud' }, roId: chief, coachId: chief })`. Setups (tests and the page): `go` (at GO, in stop motion), `room:2`, `room:3`, `hall` (rooms before it cleared by the tier one's plan, on the same draws), `contact` (room 1 at the sighting, the private's window open).
- **`SEQ_HOUSE`** (`courses.js`): brief · LOAD · MAKE READY · Standby · **GO** · Stop · UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR · "The lane is clear." Readinesses (`houseReady`, asked first by `lineReady`): Standby: on the start mark, still, Condition 1, on safe, finger off, low ready, gait Combat, the #2 in place; GO comes `STANDBY_MS` 1,500 to 4,000 after Standby (`stream(seed, 'house:standby', attempt)`), disarmed if you move off the mark or enter the mode first ("Back on your mark. Wait for GO."); **at GO the lane is hot, the timer starts, `mind.clearing` is set and you are put in stop motion** (`enterStop` via `'house'`): the first choice is free (§8 item 2). Stop: the lane over (`laneDone`).
- **`houseActors`** (arms `actors`, lived ticks): the turners' triggers (`door`: the leaf open plus `gapMs`; `zone`); the #2 (`runSlot`; his sightings by `sightOf`, his `takeInMs`, then his drill's row: Pair, Hammer from Marksmanship 12 within 7 m, the failure drill on armour, Hold on a no-shoot, by `resolveShot` with `log: false`, on `slot: 2` stands only); the instructor's walk on the catwalk over your room; the pars; the stalls.
- **`houseRules`** (arms `rules`, in place of `rangeRules` for the house): the funnel (`inFunnel` over `FUNNEL_FAULT_MS` 1,000: the fault and "Don't stop in the door!"), the flag (the muzzle line within `FLAG_M` 0.3 of the #2's body within `FLAG_REACH_M` 5 m, the rifle in hand and not at high ready: "Muzzle!", once a room), the corners (`coveredNow` for you and the #2 each tick in a room), Relaxed in a clear ("Weapon up. You're in their house."), **the safety stop** (aimed at the #2 or the instructor: "Cease fire! Cease fire!", the lane `stopped`, never a dead end). No range ND rule: a round into a ballistic wall is a miss.
- **`houseShot`** (from `recordShot`): the hit sensor as the bay's (a paper threat down at `STOP_TORSO` 2 torso or `STOP_HEAD` 1 head hit, `SENSOR_MS` 100; the armoured by its head plate at `A_MARGIN`), a no-shoot hit the fault `noshoot`; **the hostage**: any torso round is the hostage's (fault `hostage`), a head round graded `bad` or `disaster` strikes the hostage, a head hit drops the threat; the zones by room and by shooter.
- **Pars** (§4): each threat's par from its `seenMs` (its contact's, or the #2's sighting for his stands) to the first round on it by either of you; at `seenMs + parMs` with no round, the harness's low tone and "he fired first" on the sheet; a room called clear with every par met, the timer's double beep.
- **The room's end**: "Clear!" called (by row, bundle or the #2 after you) ends it; a hot spot not covered by either of you is the fault `corner` ("Your corner!"), a threat standing `standing`, the inner door neither held nor cleared `door`. **Stalls** (never a dead end): `STALL_MS` 60,000 lived with no new cover, step or round in a room: "Move on."; 30,000 more: the room's turners turn away, the fault `time`, the plan moves to the next door. The lane ends at the hall's "Clear!", at `LANE_MAX_MS` 600,000 lived from GO (`time`), dry (`dry`), or by the safety stop.
- **After Stop**: UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR to the instructor; "The lane is clear."; the **hot wash**, `WASH_MS` 90,000 behind the brief splash; then the range's `clear` fact ends the scene.
- `houseNow(state, ms)`: `{ timerMs, par, parMs, rooms: [roomRec], hall, two: { name, rank, rung, fired, hits }, dummy, contacts, faults, presses, aspects: { pause, drill, shots }, summary, end }`; `runSheetOf(state) → { rows: [{ room, words }], card }` (the one helper of the paper, the card and the instructor's words); `hotWashOf(state) → { lines, spinLine, bars: [{ room, key, takeInMs, parMs, firstMs }] }`; `againAsHouse(state, tier) → { scenario: 'test-shoothouse', seed, tier, par }`; `houseLook(state, ms) → { instructor: { x, z, y, face, say }, corners: [{ room, id, x, z, covered, by }], stands, timer }` (through `rangeLook().house`).
- **The run sheet** (`runSheetOf`): a row a room, "ROOM 1 · 7.40 S · TAKE-IN 0.80 · FIRST 2.00 · BASIC MET · 2 A · CORNERS 3 OF 3 · DOORWAY 0.30 S" (zeros out; "NO-SHOOT HIT", "HOSTAGE HIT", "MUZZLE", "DUMMY CLEARED 1.10 S"); the card §25.10.4's ("LANE A · PRIVATE · 3 ROOMS · 58.4 S · 4 OF 4 THREATS · 2 NO-SHOOTS UNTOUCHED · FIRED FIRST ON YOU: ROOM 3 · TAKE-IN 0.80 TO 1.20 S · BASIC: MET"); the instructor's one thing to do differently, from the worst number (§17.2); the spin's line once ("The Wheel puts a round low along the spin."); what a career would count toward practised.

### 2.4 What the face reads, and its numbers

`stepsOf` (the rows of §2.2, their `kind`, `beats`, `seams`, `ms`, `off`, `warn`), `bundleNow`, `contactNow`, `instinctNow` (the act's label and time for "T: …"), `houseNow`, `houseLook`, `runSheetOf`, `hotWashOf`, `roomPlanOf` (the corners drawn as covered, sparingly: a 2 px tick on the floor at each hot spot, pale until covered, gone after "Clear!"), `turnerTargets`, `actor.gait`, `kitView` (the suit's line). The panel at the stack follows §25.11 (Stack on the door · 4.7 s; Push it open · 0.6 s; Kick it · 1.2 s · 70%; Watch: … · 0.8 s; Read the door · 0.7 s; Combat ⇄ Assault; X go). A bundle's row: "T CLEAR IT · 4.0 S ● ● ● │ ● ● ●" (dots grouped by channel, the seam a bar). The running bundle shown alone with its four lanes. The instinct line's keycap names the act and its planned time before the press ("T: Stack on the door · 4.7 s"; the tier one's "T: Clear the house · 3 rooms and the hall", the lane's time). One quantity, one number: every time shown is the sim's.

### 2.5 The facts (`src/core/facts.js`; the scene writes every line; CONTRACTS §11)

- `'house'` `{ phase: 'go' | 'stacked' | 'open' | 'enter' | 'clear' | 'par' | 'fault' | 'stall' | 'stop' | 'wash' | 'end', room, who, atMs, kind?, text?, met? }`
- `'bundle'` `{ phase: 'start' | 'beat' | 'seam' | 'halt' | 'end', who, id, beat, ch, why?, atMs }` (the drill's)
- `'gait'` `{ who, from, to, atMs }` (the drill's)

### 2.6 The shared files, exactly

- `game.js` (scene): `SCENARIOS['test-shoothouse'] = testShoothouse`; nothing else.
- `domain.js` (scene): `actors` adds `houseActors(s, i, b)` after `pairsActors`; `rules` runs `houseRules` in place of `rangeRules` when `R.course === 'house'`; actions: `gait` → `shooting.js gaitAction` (the drill's), `drill:stop` → `bundle.js` stop after the beat (Backspace). Its id fields gain `armoury.range.house.twoPid`, `.chiefPid`, `.two.pid`, `.two.aid` and `.dummy.magId` (`game-ids`).
- `scenes.js` (scene): `'test-shoothouse'` built: `scenario: 'test-shoothouse'`, no `built`, `env: { preset: 'site' }` (the area carries 1 G), `outfit: 'combatSuit'`, `course: 'house'`, `stances: true`, `sheets: ['recruit', 'private', 'cpl', 'sgt', 'raider', 'tierone']`, `sheet: 'private'`, `pars: ['basic', 'advanced', 'operator']`, `endOn: { fact: 'range', phase: ['clear', 'stopped'] }`; the goal line §25.10.4's, "Corporal [name]" from the #2.
- `syntax.test.mjs` (drill): `STEPPER_HOME` (`src/sim/combat/stepper.js`: no other module schedules sub-step boundaries), `SPIN_HOME` (`src/sim/places/spin.js`: no other module defines ω or a Coriolis term), the drill data module in `ENV_HOME`'s skip list if it trips; new modules' headers.
- `instinct.js` (drill): `RULES` adds `...CQB_RULES` after `PAIRS_RULES`; the house's lines never fire off the house (`R.course === 'house'`).
- `sounds.js` (face): §2.7's rows.

### 2.7 The sound (face; every sound by code)

The house's acoustics: a hall's reverb (RT60 0.6 s, early reflections off panels 2 to 5 m; my call), indoor shots by the suit's filter (`EARPRO_K` ×0.6, the limiter's gate); the instructor's "Standby", "GO" and "Stop" on the PA, his faults as speech; the timer's tone (a 2.4 kHz beep; the double beep for a room within par) and the harness's low tone (400 Hz, 0.4 s) past a par; doors (push, pull, the kick's bang, a lock's rattle); the stack's whispered "Ready" (the #2's, on his stack); "Clear!" shouted; the suit's footsteps at 1 G (the built cadence, 4.53 a second walking; a heavier body's scuff, deck and concrete).

## 3. State shapes

### 3.1 The fields (all additive; no `SAVE_SCHEMA` bump)

```js
state.armoury.range = { course: 'house', lane: null, fp: null, area: 'melas.wheel.s4', roId, coachId, issueId, setMagId, set, phase, string: -1, hot, cmd, next, shots, brass, faults, warned, end, livedMs, nudged, stoppage, shown,
  turners: [{ key: 'turner:1', lane: 1, room: 'w4.r1', stand: '1a', name: 'the far left target', slot: 1, x, z, y, face, holds, trigger, turnAtMs, awayAtMs, hits, stoppedAtMs }],
  house: { lane: 'A', tier, par, parMs, standby: { attempt, goAtMs } | null, goAtMs, twoPid, chiefPid, stallAtMs, end: null | { why, atMs }, wash: null | { atMs },
    two: { pid, aid, rung, doing: null | <doing>, hold: null | openingId, contact: null | { key, seenMs, untilMs }, fired, hits },
    dummy: { magId, n, clickAtMs, clearedAtMs },
    rooms: [{ id, door, state: 'ahead' | 'stacked' | 'open' | 'entered' | 'clear' | 'passed', stackAtMs, openAtMs, enteredAtMs, clearAtMs, funnelMs, covered: { [hotId]: { atMs, by } },
      contacts: [{ key, seenMs, takeInMs, pauseAtMs, firstAtMs, by, parMet }], rounds, zones: { A, C, head, ring, headDown, miss, noshoot, hostage }, faults: [{ kind, atMs, text }], calls: [{ say, atMs }], presses, inner: null | 'held' | 'cleared' | 'left' }],
    hall: { …a room's } } }
state.stop.doing  // a bundle: { who, step: 'drill:house:clear>o:w4:r1', kind: 'bundle', tempo, rung, slot, door, variant: { entry, breach, stance },
                  //   beats: [{ id, k, ch, ms, after, fromMs, untilMs, st: 'wait' | 'run' | 'done' | 'cut', path?, vFrom?, vTo? }], lanes: { feet, hands, eyes, voice }, subs, fromMs, untilMs, queue? }
state.stop.watch = null | { hotId, yawRad, fromMs }
actor.gait = 'relaxed' | 'combat' | 'assault'   // absent: relaxed's walk and the built take-in (§8 item 6)
actor.v = [vx, vz]                              // only while moving in Combat or Assault
person.skills.drills.room = { rung, reps, lived: [bundleId], atMs, fixed }   // test sheets only this round
state.mind.clearing = null | { room, fromMs }   // through mind.js noteMind
state.$rooms                                    // the plans, runtime
```

Times absolute game ms on whole ticks; positions to 0.01 m. A save made anywhere in the lane (in a bundle, in a take-in window, in the #2's beat, in the hot wash's splash) loads and carries on byte for byte.

### 3.2 The upgrade (a v0.0.11 save loads)

None is needed: every field is absent in a v0.0.11 save and absent means the built behaviour. **The drill role adds two saves made by v0.0.11's own code** (`git worktree add <scratch>/base-v0.0.11 v0.0.11`): `v0.0.11-barracks-1300.json.gz` and `v0.0.11-pairs-pause.json.gz` (test-pairs at a contact pause, a step under way: the stepper's extraction's riskiest case); `game-upgrade` loads every save and carries each on byte for byte. The career's player gets no `drills` this round (§8 item 24).

### 3.3 What the shipped scenes change

Nothing, to the tick and the digest: test-handling, test-range, test-pairs, "Three bangs", "Bang", the barracks and moment 2's walk (no gait set, so no inertia; `stanceK` 1; `lightK` 1 on the bay and in lit rooms; the stepper's single-channel path byte for byte; `targetsOf` and the papers as built). The places goldens move for the new area only, on purpose, said in CHANGELOG.md.

## 4. Constants

**1 G** (the area's `spin`; BODY §16.1, §16.2; COMBAT §25.10.4): gravity 9.807 m/s²; μ 0.6 dry (5.88 m/s²); Combat walk **1.23**, Assault **2.03** m/s; push and brake `4.0` and `6.5 × (0.8 + 0.02 F) / r`, capped at μ g; kit 25 kg on 75 kg.

| Sheet (F) | push, brake m/s² | stop from Combat / Assault | a seam, Combat / Assault |
|---|---|---|---|
| boot recruit (8) | 2.88, 4.68 | 0.26 / 0.43 s | 0.69 / 1.14 s |
| private (12) | 3.12, 5.07 | 0.24 / 0.40 | 0.64 / 1.05 |
| corporal (13), sergeant (14) | 3.18 to 3.24, 5.17 to 5.27 | 0.24 / 0.39 | 0.61 to 0.62 / 1.01 to 1.03 |
| Raider (19) | 3.54, 5.75 | 0.21 / 0.35 | 0.56 / 0.93 |
| tier one (21) | 3.66, 5.88 (grip) | 0.21 / 0.35 | 0.55 / 0.90 |

**The reference room at 1 G** [computed: COMBAT §25.5's synthesis re-run with BODY §16.2's push and brake, `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r12/sheet/room1g.mjs`; Melas's column reproduces §25.5.4 to 0.01 s]. The room from 4 m down the hall, the human's own start 0.3 s by the keys:

| Marine (WF, MRK, WH, AWR) | How | Room 1 | Sighting to the first round | Take-in | Still in the doorway | Presses | Melas (§25.5.4) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| boot recruit (6, 4, 4, 2), rung 0 | by hand, keys in | **15.33 s** | 2.98 s | 0.95 s | 0.44 s | 8 | 16.89 s |
| private (15, 10, 10, 6), rung 1 | by hand, keys in | **13.79** | 2.00 | 0.80 | 0.32 | 8 | 15.41 |
| private, rung 1 | by hand, Watch set | **13.31** | 0.92 | 0.55 | 0 | 9 | 15.03 |
| corporal (34, 15, 15, 11), rung 2 | three groups by T | **8.82** | 1.53 | 0.50 | 0 | 4 | 10.01 |
| sergeant (44, 19, 19, 14), rung 3 | Clear the room | **6.13** | 0.56 | 0.25 | 0 | 2 | 7.27 |
| Raider (70, 31, 31, 31), rung 4 | Clear the house | **5.19** | 0.37 | 0.10 | 0 | 2 | 6.24 |
| tier one (93, 42, 42, 41), rung 4 | Clear the house | **4.98** | 0.30 | 0.05 | 0 | 2 | 6.03 |

The private's 13.79 s: Stack on the door 4.65 (the walk 4.0 m, high ready, the muzzle onto the door), Open 0.60, X and the keys to the sighting 1.15, the take-in 0.80 (he stops 1.24 m along the path, in the doorway), Aim 1.05, Pair 0.79, X and the walk on 1.82, the looks 2.13, "Clear!" 0.80. The tier one's 4.98 s: the approach flowing 3.42, the entry into the Assault walk 0.44, one tick, the hammer moving on 0.47, the carry on 0.60. **The private's room is 2.77 times the tier one's** (§25.13 asks the lane at least 1.5).

**The steps** (my calls, §25.5's): high ready `0.3 × 1.15 × paceOf(WH)` s; the muzzle onto the door `aimS(WH, 20°)` without the sight term; the door's hand `0.2 × paceOf(WH)` and the swing `DOOR_S` 0.4 (push); pull adds `PULL_STEP_S` 0.3 × pace (the step aside); kick `KICK_S` 1.2, Fitness against `kickDc` (an unlocked door 8, the closet 14; failed: ×1.6 and "Locked. Kick it again, or hold it."); read `READ_S` 0.7 × `paceOf(AWR)`; Watch `turn / (90 + 6 WH) + 0.4 × paceOf(WH)` (the private's 60° 0.80 s); Look `deg / (120 + 6 AWR) + 0.2 × paceOf(AWR)`; "Clear!" `CALL_S` 0.8 (0.2 over a move from rung 3); Mark `MARK_S` 0.6 × pace; an NPC's seam `goMs(WF)`; the flow from rung 3: the door pushed in the approach's last 0.6 m, the step in at two thirds open.

**The take-in's factors here**: `STANCE_K` relaxed 1.25, combat 1, assault 1.1 below rung 2; `lightK` dim (fill 0.40) ×1.13; `WHO_K` 1.5 for the hostage; the rest as built (§25.4.3).

**The scene**: `PAR_MS` basic 3,000, advanced 1,500, operator 800; `PAR_OF_TIER` recruit and private basic, corporal and sergeant advanced, Raider and tier one operator. `STANDBY_MS` 1,500 to 4,000. `FUNNEL_M` 0.5, `FUNNEL_FAULT_MS` 1,000, `THRESHOLD_M` 0.3. `FLAG_M` 0.3, `FLAG_REACH_M` 5. `TWO_SLOT_M` 1.5, `TWO_WAIT_MS` 3,000, the #2 0.65 m behind in the stack. `STALL_MS` 60,000 then 30,000; `LANE_MAX_MS` 600,000; `WASH_MS` 90,000. The turners' gaps: room 2's 300 to 1,200 ms, room 3's 500 to 1,500, the hall's 1,500 to 3,000. The dummy at round 3 to 6 of magazine 1; 29 frangible rounds.

**The spin** (PLACES §4.15; R 500 m, ω 0.1347 rad/s) [computed, `spin.py`]: a body's push `2 ω v / G0`: 3.4% at the Combat walk, **5.6% at the Assault walk** along the spin, 2.1% across; a round's offset `ω d² / v`, frangible at 790 m/s: **0.15, 0.43, 0.84, 1.71 cm at 3, 5, 7, 10 m** along the spin (low prograde, high retrograde), × 0.38 across (0.65 cm at 10 m); a marking round at 120 m/s 2.8 cm at 5 m (not issued here).

**The suit**: 16 kg, visor (no flash, no dazzle), ears `'suit'` (×0.6), `CLO.combatSuit` 1.2; no roll or gait penalty unpressurised (§8 item 15).

The flashbang variant and the bang's par (with `test-breach`, 0.0.7f, where defenders make it matter); slice the pie and limited penetration (in the data, not offered); Back out and Get down as a pause's rows; ram and charge breaches and the `breacher` record; pop-ups, the mover on a rail, `unknown` faces; layouts B and C and the chunk assembler (PLACES §9.9); slots 3 and 4; NPC defenders; the career's join (the MOUT day, the MRX) and counting reps in a career; rust; the pistol and the transition; "Gun down!" (the "Reloading!" call is in, free with a reload); the catwalk's safety rule for a muzzle raised to it; the hot wash's camera frames (its take-in bars are in); the suit's mass on the gait (BODY §16.3's load waits everywhere) and the arms' drain at high ready; the rest of the Wheel (the transfer, the other sectors).

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Each (my call) unless a source is named; the user may overrule any.

1. **The house rides the range session** (`course: 'house'`, `R.house`), as "Bang" rode pairs'; pairs' engine is not used.
2. **GO puts you in stop motion** and the lane's time runs from GO, so the stack is timed as §25.5 times it and the tier one's approach flows into his entry.
3. **Room 1 is §25.5.1's room; the lane runs east to west**, so #1, stacked right of the door, never crosses its funnel.
4. **The 1 G tables use BODY §16.2's push and brake as written**: the private stops in 0.24 s from Combat and 0.40 s from Assault (his legs' 5.07 m/s²); §25.10.4's 0.21 and 0.35 are the grip's, reached at Fitness 21. §4's table is §25.10.4's promised reprint.
5. **Inertia only in Combat and Assault**; Relaxed and an absent gait keep the built walk, so the pins and moment 2's walk hold to the tick.
6. **`actor.gait`, absent read as the built** (Relaxed's speeds, the take-in's ×1); ×1.25 only for a set `relaxed` with the rifle slung. No upgrade.
7. **V cycles the gaits only where a spec sets `stances: true`** (the house); elsewhere V stays the scored carry cycle.
8. **The singles are rung 0** (§25.7.2's own note: rung 1's "bundles" are single steps), so the boot recruit plays the lane and heads the picker (the brief: "the boot recruit too if the rungs allow").
9. **"Never the walk in"**: below rung 2 nothing but the keys crosses a door's plane into a room not yet cleared; **T at `cqb-go` is X** (the panel's "X go" row), never the feet: the user's rule 7 over §25.8.1's "T does nothing".
10. **A DI line never names a row the panel lacks; where it names one, T does it, never the shot** (as the scored scenes read rule 7).
11. **The dummy rides in the magazine you load** (round 3 to 6), so every sheet meets it; §25.10.4 had it in the third.
12. **Frangible is the house's load**; `range: false` stays for Melas's outdoor ranges.
13. **No flashbang this round** (§7): the Sergeant carries none, no par lengthened.
14. **The hostage card is one turner**: torso rounds and a head round graded bad or worse strike the hostage; To the head leads; `whoK` ×1.5.
15. **The combat EVA suit is worn unpressurised, visor down**: 16 kg, black, no red; no glove or bulk penalty in air (WEAPONS §3: the gloves' penalty "worn down"); its 25 kg kit enters push and brake, not the gait's load, so 1.23 and 2.03 m/s hold.
16. **The spin's bias moves the hole, not the odds** (1.7 cm at 10 m); the body's push is computed and said, not applied to the stride (under 6%).
17. **The hall runs along the spin, the rooms' depths across the band** (PLACES §4.15's sentence read as the rooms').
18. **`melas.wheel.s4` holds house 1 and its apron** (40 × 28 m), its 1 G on the area, the spec's env `site`; the rest of the sector waits for the Wheel's join.
19. **The instructor** is the post `melas:wheel-house-chief`, a generated staff sergeant on the catwalk above your room.
20. **The #2** is drawn from your fire team (`house:two`, the same marine every sheet) on your tier's sheet; only `slot: 2` stands; he never flags; his seams cost `goMs`.
21. **Pars** run from the threat's sighting to the first round on it by either of you; the low tone at the par, the double beep for a room within par; by sheet, set on the picker.
22. **The corporal misses the advanced par on room 1's off-corner man by 0.03 s** (1.53 against 1.50): kept; a Watch or his #2 meets it.
23. **The hot wash** is 90 s behind the brief splash, with take-in bars, no camera frames.
24. **Test sheets' reps never move**; the career's `drills` record waits for the MOUT day's join.
25. **`lightK` from `lightLevel`**: lit rooms and the bay by day read ×1; room 3's dim fill 0.40 gives −2 and ×1.13. If a pinned bay reads under 0.6, gate it on the house and report.
26. **Moving shots**: Combat −4 (−2 from Marksmanship 15); Assault from rung 2 within 10 m `mitigated(−8, MRK, 30, 0.25)`; below rung 2 Assault plants first.
27. **The flag and the stop**: the muzzle within 0.3 m of the #2 within 5 m, in hand, not at high ready, once a room; aiming at him or the instructor stops the lane (the range's `person` rule).
28. **The closet** is locked (kick DC 14) and empty: Hold it, Kick it, or leave it (fault `door`).
29. **Never a dead end**: 60 s without progress "Move on.", 30 s more and the room moves on with `time`; 10 min the lane.

**Doc changes for the lead** (as built, in the same change): COMBAT §25.5 (§4's 1 G table), §25.7 to §25.11, §25.10.4's "As built in v0.0.12" (items 1 to 29), §25.12, §25.13's names; BODY §16.1, §16.2 (the stances and their traction built); PLACES §1.6 (`swing` read), §4.15 (house 1 built); WEAPONS §2.9 (the bias in the hole), §3 (the suit worn); SKILLS §14 (`cqb.js`); VIEWS §7.4 (the bundle's rows and lanes, "T: …"), §10 (V by scene, Backspace); CONTRACTS (gaits, pars, spin); ROADMAP §4.2 and §2.2; DESIGN.md's log (items 1 to 29).

## 9. The integration (the integrator's resolutions, each my call)

30. **The stance is `actor.moveStance`** ('relaxed' | 'combat' | 'assault'), not `actor.gait`, which stays the drawn gait ('idle' | 'walk' | 'run'); a Watch is `actor.watch`; a halted bundle's rest is `state.stop.carry` (the drill's departures 1 to 3).
31. **A beat's name is its `key`, never an `id`** (the doing's beats and its lanes): the save's id walk reads every `id` field as an id, and a save made mid-bundle failed it.
32. **Room 3's far leg is the room's own, walked by the bundle** (`far` and `farlook`, #1's slot, after his sector; the plan's `far: { path, hot }` authored in `x4-plans.js`, its golden re-set to 122fbb741feb40), and by a press or the keys below it (the panel's "Move: the far leg", the DI's cqb-corner naming it first). Before, no bundle cleared it and T left the hostage card standing.
33. **The #2's "Ready." ends his stack at every rung** (the `squeeze` beat in the single too).
34. **The bay's muzzle rule is quiet in the house** (`range-muzzle` joins `RANGE_OFF_HOUSE`): its "Downrange! Everything else is people." took T at GO.
35. **In the house nothing is bracketed until a man is seen**, and only a man turned toward you (facing above 0) with a clear line is a target (shooting.js `targetsOf`, `enterStop`).
36. **The drill's and the door's rows lead the panel** (`panel.js` `FIXED_KINDS` gains 'bundle' and 'door': in the house only).
37. **Stands are drawn once seen** (view.js), as people are.
38. **A teammate's muzzle habit is not logged as yours** (carry.js: the second-person lines are the player's only).
39. **Hot spots are named from the door** (near or far by 1.5 m past the plane, left or right of its middle).
40. **A startle or CEASE FIRE during a bundle stops it after its running beats** (supp.js, handling.js), where the list's index threw.
41. **A deck is roofed** (figure.js `ROOFED_KINDS`), the dim mood has its fill colour, the hot wash's no-shoot bars carry no par, the hot wash is its own activity (`house-wash`), the contact setup faces into the room, V and Backspace are on the keys card, the v0.0.11 saves are held in `game-upgrade`.
